notes.title: Version update
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends
This update is a big update, the entire bottom layer of the game has been completely redone, and the previous games have been made into [b] computer games [/b], these computer games can be purchased in the renovation of [b] computer [/b] and play in the computer.
This update mainly updates the game's [b] gameplay [/b]. Due to the reasons of independent production, it is impossible to improve the whole game in a short time, including but not limited to scenes, sound effects, localization, etc., so the scene of the game is relatively simple at present, and lacks some sound effects, and the current language is only Chinese. Part of the scene of the game was originally intended to use the Unreal Mall scene temporarily, but after the actual test found that some free scenes are too card, and the paid scene is more expensive, so finally decided to rough a simple scene, and then gradually improve in the update.
[b] Update: [/b]
1. Now players can learn life skills and earn money by working in the game
2. There are currently 3 minigames in the game:
The first is the Ferris wheel of the amusement park (under construction), the Ferris wheel can be taken all day, in addition to the Ferris wheel in the later update will gradually add other play items including but not limited to: roller coaster, pirate ship, jump machine, etc.; The second is the tower crane worker of the Human Resources Bureau. The tower crane worker needs to learn the operation skills first and then can operate during the day to earn money. The job game will be gradually added in the later update. The third is the dream world, where you can pick up guns and fight zombies in the maze, there is no specific goal in the dream world at present, this will be gradually added in the later update.
[b] The following plan: [/b]
1. The later update will focus on the amusement park, will gradually improve the scene of the amusement park, and add new amusement park projects, the current plan is to prioritize the addition of roller coasters.
2. Now the scene of the whole game is actually several small scenes scattered, in the later update, these scenes will be gradually connected with the game scene, and gradually make a small city scene.

notes.title: Updated on May 20, 2024
notes.content:
1. Added Russian language support
2. Some texts have been modified in multiple languages
3. Fixed some item description anomalies
4. Modified the location and quantity of some items

notes.title: 2024.05.15 Patch Description
notes.content:
1. Changed the UI to enter the game, adding an option to enter the villa directly, which will be displayed when the player passes a teaching level.
2. Modified part of the scene structure in the game.
